description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
